summary: Global Asset Management Group, Inc. (GAMG) through its subsidiary RI Property Holdings, Inc. acquired 100% of the Seller's 83.125% membership interest in Memorial Real Estate Group LLC (MREG) via a Debt Equity Transfer Assumption Agreement. Total consideration was $6,455,000, comprising a $6 million one-year convertible promissory note (6% interest, convertible at 90% of 30-day VWAP) and $455,000 cash down payment. Following the transaction, Buyer SPE owns 100% of MREG and becomes sole manager. The Seller also assigns its MREG loan interest and resigns as administrative agent. Watch for regulatory filings and note conversion details for risk-arb angle.
